# ADR 0002: Rules as versioned data, scores record their version

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** Credit-card default risk scorecard API

## Context

Risk teams change rules without deployments, and past decisions must stay explainable.

## Decision

Store rules in PostgreSQL with a rule-set version; every score stores the version used; changes are validated and audited.

## Consequences

Explainable history; rule changes are a governed data change.

## Alternatives considered

Rules in code (deployment per change).
